name: Q0452-1640 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the quasar Q0452-1640, seen by Hubble.
label: q0452-hubble
story: Beside a bright quasar, Hubble searched for the faint starlight of a galaxy whose gas absorbs the quasar's light, a damped Lyman-alpha absorber. Earlier observations found two objects at that galaxy's distance, one resembling a ring galaxy.

claims.text: Q0452 is the bright quasar next to a faint damped Lyman-alpha absorber galaxy that Hubble program 13733 aimed to observe
Q0452-1640 is a quasar with a damped Lyman-alpha absorber in its spectrum
Two objects were detected at the absorber's redshift, one resembling a ring galaxy
